events.text: Year 11 brought poor growing weather (yields at 85%).
Soren Juniper founded Soren Juniper's Bakery, investing 2,031 marks.
Hollis Voss and Soren Juniper welcomed their first child, Sabine Juniper.
Perrin Heath became the richest person World 1 has ever known, with 28,272 marks.
Hollin Larkin starved to death at age 69.
The Larkin household came to an end.
Hester Ashdown starved to death at age 71, leaving behind Ivo Elwood.
Ivo Elwood starved to death at age 71.
The Elwood household came to an end.
Food shortage in World 1: only 84% of food needs are being met.
Ilsa Hollow, the oldest person in World 1, starved to death at age 76.
The Crane household came to an end.
Fenna Heath starved to death at age 31, leaving behind Madoc Moss.
Elowen Gale starved to death at age 16.
Yara Moss starved to death at age 1.
Zelie Harrow starved to death at age 40, leaving behind Jory Gale.
Soren Juniper's Bakery closed: it could no longer pay its workers.
Leofric Dell starved to death at age 42, leaving behind Halla Crane.
Eamon Upton starved to death at age 16.
Elowen Sedge starved to death at age 39, leaving behind Fitz Upton.
Frida Shaw starved to death at age 46, leaving behind Quill Rook.
Dunstan Rook starved to death at age 5.
Jarvis Upton starved to death at age 2.
Orla Upton starved to death at age 13.
Wystan Dell starved to death at age 9.
